title: Below the Belt: Renaissance Edition
description: A bawdy adult romp through the 1500s' most scandalous erotica, the curious history of penises (human and animal), and vaginas across history, culture, and anatomy — every fact web-verified.

questions.question: I Modi, the Renaissance's most notorious sex book, published its 16 engravings of lovers in this city in 1524.
A star pupil of Raphael, this artist designed I Modi's 16 erotic engravings before they were banned.
Clement VII jailed this engraver for printing I Modi, and nearly all copies were destroyed.
This satirist wrote 16 sonnets to accompany I Modi's engravings and helped win Raimondi's release from prison.
Every known copy of I Modi's first edition was destroyed — this is how many complete copies survive today.
Richard Burton's 1883 translation made this ancient Sanskrit treatise by Vatsyayana the West's go-to sex manual.
This 1972 Alex Comfort bestseller was organized like a cookbook, with chapters titled Starters and Main Courses.
questions.answer: What is The Joy of Sex?

questions.question: Sheikh Nefzawi's erotic manual, translated by Richard Burton in 1886, bears this fragrant title.
This 1976 study drew on questionnaires from about 3,000 women, finding most don't orgasm from intercourse alone.
Richard Burton's Kama Shastra Society brought this Kalyana Malla manual — 'Stage of Love' — to English readers in 1885.
In Latin, 'penis' originally meant this body part of animals — only later did it name human anatomy.
The medical term priapism, for a persistent unwanted erection, is named for this Greek fertility god.
This fashion pouch peaked in the 1540s, when Henry VIII's tournament armor sported a famously padded one.
Romans hung these bronze phallic wind chimes, often near doorways, to ward off the evil eye.
In 1564, this anatomist posthumously published the first uncontested European description of a condom — a linen sheath against syphilis.
This country's Phallological Museum, founded by a retired teacher in 1997, finally acquired its first human specimen in 2011.
A viral 2007 study revealed this bird's corkscrew-shaped penis can stretch nearly half its body length.
Walruses, bats, and most primates have this penis bone — humans are among the few mammals that lack one.
This crustacean's penis can extend up to eight times its body length — the largest such ratio in the animal kingdom.
In this dueling ritual, two hermaphroditic marine flatworms try to stab each other; the loser carries the eggs.
The Latin word 'vagina' originally meant this item that holds a sword.
questions.answer: What is a sheath or scabbard?

questions.question: Until 17th-century anatomists set the record straight, medical texts depicted the vagina as this male organ turned inside out.
In his 1559 anatomy text, Realdo Colombo claimed to have discovered this small erectile organ above the vaginal opening.
Eve Ensler's play based on interviews with 200 women premiered off-off-Broadway in October 1996 and spawned V-Day.
The 'G' in G-spot honors this German-born gynecologist, who described an erotic zone along the urethra in 1950.
Anatomically, this outer region includes the labia and clitoris — while the vagina is the internal canal.
The anatomical term 'labia' is simply the Latin word for these.
Beneficial bacteria keep a healthy vagina's pH around 3.8 to 4.5 — chemically speaking, that makes it this.
Introduced by Procter & Gamble in 1983, this pad brand famously demonstrated absorbency with mysterious blue liquid.
Described in 1880, these paraurethral glands, considered the female counterpart of the prostate, bear a gynecologist's surname.
